name: Tally
subtitle: Monthly budget, kept simple

privacy.storage: On-device only (UserDefaults). No account, no cloud, no ads.

description:
Tally is a calm monthly budget for iPhone, built for iOS 26.

See what’s left this month, log income and spending, and keep a savings goal in view — without accounts or ads. Everything stays on your phone.

• Remaining balance always in reach
• Income, spent, and saved at a glance
• Activity list grouped by day
• Spending by category
• Savings goal with progress
• Add, edit, and delete transactions

Tally is built for people who want a ledger, not a social network.
whatsNew: Requires iOS 26. Liquid Glass tab bar and system glass controls. Amounts now accept the decimal separator your keyboard shows, and an emptied ledger stays empty.
